title: /review
line: Read the staged change and report a concrete defect.

beats.caption: You ask for a read-only review of the staged diff.
The staged CLI treats the flag as the name.
The finding gives you a location and an input.

takeaway.title: Make the finding checkable
takeaway.line: Include the changed line, the trigger, and the observed result.

title.text: Slash review uses the implementation review skill to look for defects in your staged change.

scene.text: Here, the new shout flag is still read as the first positional argument. Pi runs the example to confirm the wrong greeting and points to the line that causes it.

takeaway.text: You get a finding with the location, the exact input, and what went wrong. The staged change is left as it was.
